title: Commerce Cloud storefront MCP server for agentic commerce (announcement-level)
problem: Let customers shop through AI platforms as well as the storefront.
facts: SAP lists conversational AI shopping through an MCP server in its Q2 2026 CX release.
Coverage states the server exposes catalog, pricing, inventory and promotions to AI platforms.
A commentator notes each merchant deploys the server and that much capability is roadmap.
interpretations: Exposing pricing and inventory to external agents raises contract-price, entitlement and rate-limit questions the sources do not address.
review_exercise: List what must be true before exposing B2B contract pricing via an MCP server.
adaptation: Discovery prompt for B2B clients; needs SAP documentation.
